verdict.rationale: Termius docs explicitly state that infrastructure is stored/encrypted locally and users can "connect directly to your servers without the internet, a proxy, or VPN," directly matching the story. This is corroborated by SSH client architecture (direct SSH connections, jump host support) rather than a mandatory cloud relay. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of no-cloud-relay claim and clarity on how sync features interact with this offline mode.
